title: Bano ki dilruba sakina jaa'n
body:
Banu ki dilruba sakina jaa'n
chal basi mailaqa sakina jaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh ki shehdaai aur meri duqtar
hogayi kyu qafa sakina jaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
sadqe hoti hai tum pe maa uttho
Kehna maano mera sakina jaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
dard kaano ka kaisa hai bolo
mujh se bolo zara sakina jaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
haal asghar ka ab bayaa'n keeje
dil bhar aaya mera sakina jaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
haaye zindaane shaam me tumko
aayi kya qaza sakina jaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaa rahi hu mai lo quda hafiz
Ae meri dilruba sakina jaa'n
